title: Where the Supreme Band played and for whom
summary: The Supreme Band played along the coast, Mobile and the Great Southern Hotel, mostly weekends for white audiences and advertised dances from trucks.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Where did you play? We played Mobile all along the coast, played at the old Great Southern Hotel. Practically every week before we went down in Gulf Coast, sometimes twice a week. Then we played Mobile a gang of times, Eureka Gordon and several other places. I forgot the names of them. You know Bunk used to play at the Great Southern Hotel.

Yes. He used to come over here. How long ago that Great Southern Hotel was born here? I heard him, but I don't know him. He's a trumpet player. He used to come over here. How long ago that Great Southern Hotel was born here? I didn't have to go to a long time ago. Long time ago. Let me see now. What years were you with the Supreme? Is that the band you joined right after you came by? Right from school, that's right. And how long did that band stay up with you in it? For years and years. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know him. I don't know him. I don't know him. He's a trumpet player. He used to come over here. How long ago? Every one of them died except me. Mm-hm. He had a fellow who used to play a drum with us.

He was operating a cafe and . He had been to anybody . Every one of them died except me. They had a fellow who used to play a drum with us. He was operating a cafe and he ain't been dead by the United States yet. Alexander. He looked better than he did. Yeah. What do you? I was talking to him and he said, you know, one thing you and I got a lot to be thankful for, all the members of our orchestra are dead except you and I. And about a few months after that he died and we had that conversation.
How many nights a week would you work with that band?
About three nights on the average.
Weekends? Middle of the week or what? Most of the weekends. And who did you play for? Mostly for white people. Would you play for societies or parades or anything like that?
Yeah, they were so sorry they haven't been parades. Used to advertise doing trucks, you know. Get on the trucks and advertise for dances.
I've been on a couple of those but you don't see them much anymore. No.
Once upon a time in the Orleans you could see them all around there. You could see three or four of them. Hook wheels. Lock wheels, that's right.
